title_zh: The natural world — 第4节可背诵讲义
body_en: Mountains, rivers, and forests work together. Rain falls, plants grow, and animals find homes. When one part changes, other parts feel it. In science class we draw a simple food chain and talk about why green plants matter. Walk outside this week and write five things you see in nature.
body_zh: 山、河、森林彼此协作。雨水落下，植物生长，动物找到家。一部分一变，其它部分也会感受到。科学课上我们画简单的食物链，讨论绿植为何重要。这周走到户外，写下你在自然中看到的五样东西。
